Title: Azure Stack HCI now available in China

Body.Content:
Azure Stack HCI is a new hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) operating system delivered as an Azure service that provides the latest security, performance, and feature updates. Extend your datacenter to the cloud with Azure Backup, Azure Monitor, and Azure Security Center.

Azure Stack HCI is now available in the China cloud - making it very easy to get all the benefits of Azure Stack HCI.  You can get started in China with a 60-day free trial.

Start your trial today.
